name: agent
description: Native Pi model and supplied-tool conversation, scheduled by XState.

maxModelCalls.description: Maximum model requests per prompt, including the final response. A tool batch requires room for a follow-up model request.

maxToolCalls.description: Maximum top-level tool calls per prompt. An over-budget batch is rejected before executing any of its tools. Code Mode has its own nested-call limits.

model.description: Optional native Pi catalog selector. A CLI-selected model binding takes precedence.

systemPrompt.description: Agent instructions; the caller's working directory is appended.
